label: Raucle gate: policy-enforced tool calls with signed receipts
hints: Use raucle-gate to run account lookups. Every call is checked against policy by the raucle gateway and returns a signed receipt binding the delegated-authority chain; allowed calls exit 0, denied calls exit 1 with the receipt id, escalations exit 2. If the gate is unreachable the call fails closed (exit 3) and must not be retried without an operator.
